verdict.rationale: Angular ships @angular/router as an official first-party module, explicitly called out in Angular's own docs ('first-party modules for forms, routing, and more') and confirmed by community users noting '@angular/router is better than AngularJS routing'. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party documentation snippets on router APIs/features, and more recent independent corroboration (the one critical router comment is from Angular 2's early days, not a current contradiction).
